{"timeline":[{"date":"2002-08-09","headline":"Release of XXX","text":"XXX, an American action film directed by Rob Cohen, was released in theaters. {"timeline":[{"date":"-0058","headline":"Roman Conquest","text":"Julius Caesar conquers the area that is now the southern part of the Netherlands, integrating it into the Roman Empire."},{"date":"0695","headline":"Christianization Begins","text":"The Christianization of the Netherlands begins with the missionary work of Saint Willibrord, who establishes the Archdiocese of Utrecht."},{"date":"0800","headline":"Carolingian Empire","text":"The area becomes part of the Carolingian Empire under Charlemagne, leading to increased political and cultural integration with the rest of Europe."},{"date":"0839","headline":"Treaty of Verdun","text":"The Treaty of Verdun divides the Carolingian Empire, with the Netherlands becoming part of Middle Francia."},{"date":"1433","headline":"Burgundian Netherlands","text":"The Netherlands comes under the control of the Duchy of Burgundy, marking the beginning of centralized rule."},{"date":"1568","headline":"Eighty Years' War Begins","text":"The Dutch Revolt against Spanish rule begins, leading to the Eighty Years' War and the eventual independence of the Netherlands."},{"date":"1581","headline":"Act of Abjuration","text":"The northern provinces of the Netherlands declare independence from Spain with the Act of Abjuration."},{"date":"1648","headline":"Treaty of Westphalia","text":"The Treaty of Westphalia officially recognizes the independence of the Dutch Republic, ending the Eighty Years' War."},{"date":"1795","headline":"Batavian Republic","text":"The Batavian Republic is established following the French Revolutionary Wars, replacing the Dutch Republic."},{"date":"1815","headline":"Kingdom of the Netherlands","text":"The Kingdom of the Netherlands is established following the defeat of Napoleon, uniting the northern and southern Netherlands."},{"date":"1830","headline":"Belgian Revolution","text":"Belgium secedes from the Kingdom of the Netherlands, becoming an independent nation."},{"date":"1940-05-10","headline":"German Invasion","text":"Nazi Germany invades the Netherlands during World War II, leading to occupation until 1945."},{"date":"1944","headline":"Operation Market Garden","text":"Allied forces launch Operation Market Garden in an attempt to liberate the Netherlands from German occupation."},{"date":"1945-05-05","headline":"Liberation Day","text":"The Netherlands is liberated from Nazi occupation by Allied forces."},{"date":"1949","headline":"NATO Founding Member","text":"The Netherlands becomes a founding member of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO)."},{"date":"1957","headline":"European Economic Community","text":"The Netherlands becomes a founding member of the European Economic Community, a precursor to the European Union."},{"date":"2002","headline":"Euro Adoption","text":"The Netherlands adopts the euro as its official currency, replacing the Dutch guilder."},{"date":"2010-10-10","headline":"Dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles","text":"The Netherlands Antilles is dissolved, with Curaçao and Sint Maarten becoming constituent countries within the Kingdom of the Netherlands."}]}
